messages.subject: Call server.R function within server.R
parts:
Is it possible to call server.R function within server.R?  

For example, on the server side, I have a a function output$print<-reactivePrint(function(){...}.  At the beginning of this I want to call output$print2<-reactiveText(function(){...} and then call output$print2 later within output$print.

Thanks.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Call server.R function within server.R
parts:
You can't refer to output$name directly. But you can introduce a variable:

foo <- reactiveText(function() { ... })

output$print2 <- foo

output$print <- reactivePrint(function() {
  ...
  paste(foo(), ...)
})
